selection_basis: a comprehensive freeze would invent decisions the accepted evidence marks unresolved
typed ABI alone can never authorize Coordinator or owner source
owner-first packets would duplicate unsettled shared encodings across seven domains
a fail-closed shared register advances dependency closure without selecting unknown semantics

fixed_facts: 57 recipe identities and 57 facade entrypoint names are ordered and unique
unresolved_decisions: parameter and return types, structs, selectors, interface id, schema, and marker
evidence_required: Solidity-compatible ABI table plus selector and interface-id recomputation with hostile field-order tests

fixed_facts: Registry is a typed immutable directory and facade that forwards an authenticated original caller
unresolved_decisions: direct-caller versus Registry-forwarded ingress and exact Registry-to-Coordinator authentication
evidence_required: typed ingress protocol and spoofing tests without generic routing

fixed_facts: every recipe and every mutating owner authenticates the exact original caller
unresolved_decisions: derivation, forwarding field, anti-spoof rule, and relation to msg.sender
evidence_required: canonical caller envelope and direct, relayed, and spoofed-caller hostile cases

fixed_facts: seven owner domains are snapshotted in matrix order before the first mutation
unresolved_decisions: typed reads, return fields, revision width, commitment, state-root, tip encodings, and failure rules
evidence_required: one exact snapshot schema and hostile stale or malformed snapshot tests for each owner

fixed_facts: matrix action identities and owner call order are exact
unresolved_decisions: typed mutation functions, calldata, acknowledgements, expected recipe and revision checks, and errors

fixed_facts: 64 replay surfaces have one exact owner each
unresolved_decisions: domain-separated preimages, field order, allocation, consumption, uniqueness, supersession, retirement, and conflict rollback
